title: SunOpta Inc. 8-K Filing — 2026-04-17
summary: SunOpta Inc., a food/beverage company dual-listed on Nasdaq (STKL) and TSX (SOY), filed a Form 8-K reporting shareholder voting results from a special meeting held April 16, 2026. Shareholders approved a statutory arrangement under which Pegasus BidCo B.V., through subsidiary 2786694 Alberta Ltd., will acquire all outstanding common shares. The Arrangement Resolution passed with 95,088,870 votes for, 1,728,826 against, and 151,336 abstentions, representing approximately 80% voter turnout.
key_points: Record date for the meeting was March 10, 2026, with 118,372,041 Common Shares and 2,932,453 Special Shares eligible to vote
Approximately 80% of eligible shares (96,969,032) were present virtually or by proxy, constituting quorum
Arrangement Resolution passed: 95,088,870 for, 1,728,826 against, 151,336 abstentions
Executive Compensation Proposal passed: 79,953,814 for, 16,874,482 against, 140,736 abstentions
Acquirer is Pegasus BidCo B.V., a Dutch entity, through 2786694 Alberta Ltd. as the purchaser
The arrangement agreement was dated February 6, 2026, requiring Ontario Superior Court approval (interim order March 16, 2026)
